subject.title: fix: preserve working installs on unsupported Node

question: Must this PR attach the promised Windows Node 24.14.0 and macOS Node 25.2.1 after-fix rollback transcripts before merge, or is the current focused-test and package-manager probe evidence sufficient?
rationale: The patch changes upgrade and lifecycle behavior across three package managers, and only a maintainer can accept or waive the repository's real-behavior proof gate for the exact affected platforms.

options.title: Require rollback proof
options.body: Require redacted exact-head Windows and macOS runs showing install rejection before swap and the previous OpenClaw CLI still runnable.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Merge based on focused tests and package-manager probes while explicitly accepting the remaining affected-platform rollback uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require rollback proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted exact-head Windows and macOS runs showing install rejection before swap and the previous OpenClaw CLI still runnable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places updater handoff and adjacent compatibility behavior in this contributor's area.
